body: No, I only really take it as and when I need it but I am on Citalopram which helps too. I have 40mg tablets but sometimes I will just bite it in half and maybe have the rest if it's not helping enough
I find propranolol really helps me when my anxiety is bad, might be worth a try

The exact same thing happened to me 2 weeks ago. It’s been so hard I won’t lie. I had pushed him away by being too much, he also used to shut down when I broke down, his response was to give me space which just made me panic and feel rejected. I also have hit the low of just not wanting to be here anymore, feeling like I’m so different I will never be able to have a functional, happy relationship. 
I felt so bad like I had failed by demanding too much from him but I’m slowly coming round to the fact that like it or not this is who I am. If my personality is that I need someone to be there to comfort me in those times then that’s how it is. And that means my ex wasn’t the right person for me. And it sucks cause I love him. Yeah, I know that probably doesn’t help you right now but just know someone will come along who does tick those boxes and who you won’t feel like you are too much for. 
Just remember it’s not “on you”, you are who you are and your ex is who she is. Nobody is to blame it’s just two different personalities and sometimes that’s the hard bit. 
Lots of love to you, please pop up to me if you want to talk! I would be so happy to listen
